# release/SUBMISSION-MANIFEST.txt: the allowlist of the submission archive (LEANREPO M3, 2026-10-19).
#
# Read by `scripts/Build-CoreBundle.ps1 -Submission`. One repository path per line. A path ending in "/" stands for
# every tracked file under that directory; any other line names one file, which must exist when the archive is built
# (the three .bbl files are generated by `scripts/Build-Paper.ps1`). A listed path that is missing fails the build,
# and nothing outside the list is copied. `-NoPdf` drops the three PDFs.
#
# Left out on purpose (decision D4, 2026-10-19): suggestions/, docs/archive/ (except the one evaluation script the
# appendix cites), docs/reference-notes/, the round plans of docs/, audit-notes/, the plans and revision notes at the
# top level, paper/note_sections/ and the notes root, paper/submission/, the review document, agent and editor
# configuration (.github/, .vscode/, .mcp.json, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) and the reference libraries.
